title: Aesthetica Art Prize 2026 - International Competition
description: Enter two artworks for a £10,000 main prize, a group exhibition at a major public gallery, and Aesthetica Magazine coverage.
descriptionDetailed: The Aesthetica Art Prize celebrates contemporary art in all its forms, from painting and drawing to video, sculpture, performance, photography, digital art, and mixed media. Open to artists at any level worldwide, it offers a £10,000 main prize and a £1,000 emerging prize, with shortlisted work exhibited at a major public gallery.

entry.feeNote: Regular entries cost £25 from December 1, 2025 to October 11, 2026, and late entries cost £35 from October 12-18, 2026. Each entry includes two works of art.

prize.description: The main prize winner receives £10,000, and the emerging prize winner receives £1,000 plus a £250 voucher for Winsor & Newton products. Winners and shortlisted artists are included in a group exhibition at a major public gallery, receive editorial coverage in Aesthetica Magazine and online, and get a profile on the Aesthetica website. Longlisted artists receive a profile and ongoing support for their practice.

audience.eligibilityLabel: For artists of all levels worldwide
audience.eligibilityDetail: Open to all practitioners working at any level, including students, with no nationality restriction. Work in any genre and on any theme is accepted, including painting, drawing, video, sculpture, installation, performance, photography, digital art, film, ceramics, illustration, and mixed media. Each entry includes two works of art.
